message: そして聖夜
Lively crowds and sacred melodies can be heard echoing from all across the academy.
For now, each event is overseen by its coordinator, while we officers stand by in the Student Council room in case an emergency arises that they can't handle alone.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we really have nothing to do right now, huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「You are the big boss of Ryuusei Academy, after all. You ought to carry yourself with a bit more composure.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, she's asleep. Lolotte's a real big shot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha! That settles it--Lolo-chan is gonna be the next Student Council President!」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed, completely unfazed by anything... They call that maintaining divine composure, don't they?」

name: Azel
message: 「Divine? No, she is an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-A-A-An... You can't eat Mr. Ladybug...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What kind of dream is she having?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz~~ zzz~~」

name: Misa
message: 「...The Student Council room is quiet today. You can hear Lolotte-san's soft breathing so clearly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, the Crusaders have become a huge group lately. Back at the beginning, it was just this many of us, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Including Azel, there are only five of us here...」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san... are you worried about Re-Crea?」

name: Azel
message: 「That is not it. It is simply that I am no longer of any use.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true at all! You've been researching Re-Crea all this time, haven't you? You're helping us out plenty!」

name: Misa
message: 「Come now, don't make such a gloomy face! That's right, Azel-san! Let's use this waiting time to review the song!」

name: Azel
message: 「The song... you say?」

name: Misa
message: 「You haven't been participating in practice at all, have you? It's not too late to start even now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't push yourself too hard or you'll lose your voice, so keep it in moderation, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I know that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The dance party's starting in just a bit. And then it's a big sing-along with Misa's song.」

name: Synn
message: 「Dancing, huh... Senpai seems like she'd be good at it, so I was hoping to learn some tips from her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's probably over at the Wagashi Club or something, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Most likely. Shio is helping out with her club's event, too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why don't you go show your face at the Sweets Club as well, Nanaka-san?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks. But I'll wait until Ria-senpai gets here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are your song preparations all set?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course! I haven't missed a single detail.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「T-The final boss has arrived.」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Onee-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, well? Ria-senpai's with her too.」

name: Helena
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, members of the Student Council.」

name: Helena
message: 「A Bylous has appeared.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep. Right around Finis Tower, going 'shuwacchi'」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Helena
message: 「And then, and then! Apparently a Re-Crea showed up too, all like 'gyupaaa'!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san! That's not something to joke around about!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, you're right. It looks like Melilot is fighting them off, so let's hurry and go.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone! Crusaders, move out!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okey-dokey.」

name: Helena
message: 「And meanwhile, I will automatically--」

name: Ria
message: 「Run, everyone! Big Sis is gonna explode!」

name: Helena
message: 「Automatically teach Azel how to make pork miso soup.」

name: Helena
message: 「Azel, I'm counting on you for the soup kitchen. Let's all eat together once the decisive battle is over.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. It's a festival for the entire academy to take part in, after all. I won't let you sit around with nothing to do♪」

name: Helena
message: 「We're counting on you, Crusaders. I wish you all the best of luck!」

name: Synn & Misa
message: 「Yes, ma'am!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Haa, haa... Foolishness. I haven't been consumed by Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「A power that caused even Soltia's body to crumble... Yet you succeeded in suppressing it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, what a display of madness... Do you also desire the rebirth of the world?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「My resolve... was set long ago. Even poisoned by Re-Crea... I will never lose sight of my cherished ambition...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What an incomplete fusion... Magic power and Spirit Power are clashing against each other...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You haven't brought Re-Crea under control at all! At this rate, it's too dangerous!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph... The Demon Lord is still inexperienced. To fight him... haa, haa... it makes for a good handicap.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For what purpose...? What ambition could you possibly wish to achieve by going so far as to defeat the Demon Lord...?」

name: Bylous
message: 「...I refuse to shoulder pointless burdens. Unlike you... or Soltia.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It isn't a matter of sanity or insanity. From the very beginning, you were driven toward obsession, weren't you?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Haa, haa... I won't deny it... Ghh!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just as I thought, the runaway power is eating away at your body... To fight in such a condition--」

name: Synn
message: 「Meliloooot!」

name: Bylous
message: 「...The Demon Lord is an existence drawn to Re-Crea. Hehehe... Just as the legends say.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous... You did all of this just for that...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you alright, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone in Crusaders! Please defeat that man... defeat Bylous!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Impressive. You catch on quick.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're Bylous...!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...W-What is this sensation...」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Lolotte...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-This is bad... I can feel an ominous pressure coming from this Demon...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Urgh... Uwaaah... Calm down!! My own will... Urgh, guwaaaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm okay!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Crap... This is seriously bad.」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's generating the same force field as the very first Re-Crea... the largest Re-Crea in history!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Me, taken over by Re-Crea... Rebirth of the world... Tch, I don't care about--!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous is on the verge of losing his consciousness to Re-Crea. Fortunately, his mind is clashing against it, weakening its influence.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If we're going to stop Re-Crea from running wild, now is our only chance!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura... what are we going to do?」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it obvious...!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's right, Demon Lord. That power of yours exists for moments just like this.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, it's unbelievable. The entire Re-Crea is contained inside that bastard alone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though the power's so ridiculously massive he can't hold it all in, so it's overflowing.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Rebirth of the world... If it lets me fight the Demon Lord...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Fine by me!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now, come at me, Demon Lord!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun......」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay, Misa...... This power...... We've worked so hard for this exact moment.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes...... You're right!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I believe in everyone...... So, everyone, believe in me too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes!! Let's go, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not Heaven--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not the Demon World--」

name: Ria
message: 「And not the Human World--」

name: Synn
message: 「We won't let Re-Crea have its way!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「......A supremely cool-headed resolve, utterly devoid of anger or fear.」

name: Bylous
message: 「A quietly burning Demon Lord...... Hehehe, hahahahaha!」

name: Bylous
message: 「This moment! I have been waiting for this very instant!」

name: Synn
message: 「With everyone's power......! We'll blast Re-Crea right out of Bylous!」
